2609.04173.title: Last Translation Benchmark
2609.04173.paper_summary: For scientific progress, we need benchmarks that test the limits of state-of-the-art models, and evaluation methods that inform us about failure cases. As models get stronger, standard benchmarks for machine translation are approaching saturation. Further, automatic translation metrics are unreliable, vulnerable to reward-hacking, and provide unactionable assessments. Even gold human evaluation is not problem-free, because it often lacks reproducibility, objectivity, and scalability. Overall, this prevents us from tracking objective progress in the field and identifying pathways for improvement. We introduce the Last Translation Benchmark, a collection of human-authored and peer-reviewed examples (texts, images, audio, videos) that break leading machine translation models. We also present a new evaluation approach: each example comes with handcrafted verification rules describing concrete failure cases on that example, therefore allowing reliable and actionable future evaluation. The Last Translation Benchmark is a live dataset that accepts ongoing contributions. The latest version is LTBv1, containing accepted contributions prior to September 1st 2026, with future releases planned as new data is continuously collected.
2609.04173.paper_summary_zh: 為了科學進步，我們需要測試最先進模型極限的基準，以及告訴我們失敗案例的評估方法。隨著模型變得更強大，機器翻譯的標準基準正接近飽和。此外，自動翻譯指標不可靠，容易受到獎勵操控的影響，並且提供不可行的評估。即使是金標準的人類評估也並非沒有問題，因為它往往缺乏可重複性、客觀性和可擴展性。總的來說，這妨礙了我們在該領域跟踪客觀進展和識別改進路徑。我們介紹了最後翻譯基準，這是一個由人類撰寫和同行評審的範例集合（文本、圖像、音頻、視頻），能夠突破領先的機器翻譯模型。我們還提出了一種新的評估方法：每個範例都附有手工編寫的驗證規則，描述該範例的具體失敗案例，因此允許可靠且可行的未來評估。最後翻譯基準是一個持續接受貢獻的實時數據集。最新版本是LTBv1，包含在2026年9月1日之前接受的貢獻，未來的版本計劃在新數據持續收集的情況下發布。
